##### Project general facts

Lumina Vista by ARIB Developments is a contemporary residential building with original architecture and a serene outlook over the landscaped greenery of the community. The building rises from a ground floor and a podium level to the residential floors, with clean lines and generous glazing that bring natural light into every home. The collection offers studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom duplexes, designed for professionals, couples and small families seeking a calm, practical home.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool with a children's pool and splash zone, a fully equipped gym, an aqua gym and a sauna for relaxation after a busy day. A children's play area, a clubhouse, lounge and recreation zones and a bar counter by the pool create welcoming social spaces, while a welcoming lobby, concierge and valet services, covered parking, lifts, high-speed internet and retail outlets at ground level add everyday comfort and convenience.

Apartments feature modern finishes in soft light-grey tones, crafted from high-quality materials, with built-in appliances and smart home features throughout. Thoughtful layouts make efficient use of space, while large windows and balconies extend the living areas outdoors and frame open views. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant, family-friendly community at the centre of the city, known for its circular layout of landscaped parks, low- and mid-rise residential buildings and townhouses. Circle Mall, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, nurseries, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home, while more than thirty parks and play areas give the community a green, relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Hills Mall, Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Marina are a short drive away, while Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach, along with Dubai Sports City, Dubai Autodrome and Dubai Miracle Garden for leisure and family days out.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular rental markets in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs attracts young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy and steady demand. Ready apartments with resort-style amenities and competitive prices underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
